info.name: Claim Assessment Demo
info.description: Import this collection and create a public Postman mock server. Both endpoints return result, claimId, correlationId, and the complete saved claim with HTTP 200. Select pass/fail examples by name. Responses contain static example data, not an automatic echo of the incoming request. All people and claim data are synthetic.
